stem:
Tariq traces how water and minerals move in a plant from the roots to the leaves and other plant parts.

Which path is correct?

options.text: Water and minerals move from roots through xylem to leaves and other plant parts.
Water and minerals move from roots to leaves through phloem.
Water and minerals travel from leaves down through xylem to roots.
Xylem carries water and minerals to leaves only, not to other plant parts.

teacher.key_rationale: Xylem carries water and minerals upward from roots to leaves and other parts. Phloem is the wrong tissue; downward travel reverses the path; limiting xylem to leaves alone is too narrow.
